name: triad-auth
description: Triad identity broker on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.db:generate: pnpm exec auth generate --config src/better-auth/schema.ts --output src/better-auth/drizzle-schema.ts --yes && sed -zi -e 's/, {\s*mode: "json",\?\s*}//g' -e 's/\.default(\[\])/.default("[]")/g' src/better-auth/drizzle-schema.ts && pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm exec cf d1 migrations apply 40220009-d502-4afd-ab7b-54495016720f --local --persist-to .cloudflare/state
scripts.deploy:nightly: pnpm exec cf d1 migrations apply c4c8e874-a463-4c22-8389-8911627c055d && pnpm exec cf deploy --mode nightly
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm exec cf d1 migrations apply 40220009-d502-4afd-ab7b-54495016720f && pnpm exec cf deploy --mode production
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && pnpm exec astro preview
